description: This file defines a React functional component 'DashboardTeam' that manages team selection in a dashboard UI, using React hooks and UI components from @tremor/react. It handles fetching proxy settings, determines which teams to display based on user role and proxy settings, and renders a team selection dropdown.

methods.name: DashboardTeam
methods.description: React component for displaying and selecting user teams with dynamic proxy settings and access control.

methods.name: getProxySettings
methods.description: Asynchronous function to fetch proxy UI settings if not already set and an access token is available.
